subject.title: [Feedback]: 用户要求退还因AI未能完成桌面操控任务而消耗的积分

question: Should the two MuMuClaw reports be consolidated into one evidence-backed OpenClaw technical issue while the credit refund is routed to MuMuClaw billing/support?
rationale: The repository cannot administer external credits, but the paired incident includes unverified technical allegations that could fit OpenClaw's computer-use direction if a concrete core or plugin contract failure is demonstrated.

options.title: Split billing and technical work
options.body: Route reimbursement externally and keep this issue only after the reporter supplies evidence isolating a documented OpenClaw failure.

options.title: Keep both pending routing
options.body: Leave both reports open until the MuMuClaw owner confirms the billing and technical escalation process.

recommendation.title: Split billing and technical work
recommendation.body: Route reimbursement externally and keep this issue only after the reporter supplies evidence isolating a documented OpenClaw failure.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent ownership of the Windows node, computer-use, and system.run approval boundary makes him the strongest available repository-side decision owner.
